elements_selected.content: Extract session tracking into a shared module that persists state to a JSON file. Create sense_mcp/session.py with: (1) SessionState class holding surfaced dict {file_path: {count, last_ts}} and query history [{query, ts, surfaced_files}] — same structure as current _session_surfaced and _session_queries but serialisable (no embeddings stored; circling detection re-embeds past query texts on demand). (2) load() and save() using /tmp/sense-session-state.json (single file — MCP server has no session_id concept). Use file locking (fcntl.flock) for safe concurrent read/write between hook and MCP. (3) record_surfaced(results) — updates surfaced counts. (4) record_query(query_text, surfaced_files) — appends to query history. (5) get_surfaced_penalty(file_path, base_penalty) — same formula as current: penalty^count, floor 0.05. (6) get_circling_files(query_embedding, embed_fn, threshold=0.75) — re-embeds past query texts via provided embed_fn, returns file paths from queries with similarity >= threshold. (7) LRU eviction on surfaced (cap from config.surfaced_cap), rolling window on queries (cap from config.max_queries). (8) last_query_time field for hook cooldown. The module must be importable by both server.py and hook.py without circular imports — do NOT import from server.py or config.py at module level; accept config values as parameters.
